(a) Acoustics
for Speech
Relates to speech with foremost objectives of
intelligibility. A space should have relatively
lower reverberation time for speech. Generally,
it covers narrow range of frequency spectra in
lower-mid level (about 170 to 4,000 Hz, for an
average dynamic range of 42 dBA).
